retrieval.validation_note: v11 retains the compact global retrieval floor but adds always-on same-brand rescue and cross-retailer private-label rescue. The v10 200-pair benchmark was found to be unrepresentative of full-catalog low-score same-brand/private-label cases.

performance_notes: v17 FINAL preserves the v16 hot path and all numeric retrieval/router/GPT settings: compact rare-token/spec retrieval, 2,500-row short-lived workers, adaptive deterministic concurrency up to 4, SQLite Store-B detail storage, persistent lazy B-fact caching, deep scoring only for top 3 plus protected exact-title candidates, GPT groups of 24 with concurrency 12, and the bounded secondary medium-reasoning pass. The only normal-path addition is one final exact-SKU identity/catalog guard over provisional MATCH rows using the same single batched Store-B metadata read already used by final merge; checks are in-memory and add no full-catalog retrieval, evidence-scoring, candidate-rescoring, or API pass. Azure content-filter recovery recursively splits only rejected GPT groups to isolate the offending retail title while leaving normal batches unchanged. The clean submission launcher automatically invokes betterbasket_final_certification.py after final merge; this pass touches only certified MATCH rows and the already-built Store-B metadata cache. The final frozen polish also enforces national-brand many-to-one package-count uniqueness: if one B item_id receives incompatible explicit A counts, B metadata must identify the supported count or the conflicting counted rows are deferred to REVIEW.
